author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: इह लोके ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रं न हि विद्यते ।  तज्ज्ञानं स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः योगविषये सम्यक् सिद्धिमान्संसिद्ध (द्धी) ज्ञानोपायः सन् कालेन बहुना आत्मनि विंअदति प्राप्नोति ॥ ४.३८॥
translation:
In the world, there is verily no purifier like wisdom; and that (wisdom), he who is accomplished as to means attains in Atman in the long run. (38)
A. Having thus extolled wisdom, the immediate step for it as well as its fruit the Lord states thus:
